mapper.select: SELECT last_ip AS ip, SUM(failed_count) AS attempts, COUNT(*) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS locked, MAX(last_fail_time) AS last_time FROM rx_login_attempt WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip <> '' GROUP BY last_ip ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 100
